name: ESP32-2432S028 "Cheap Yellow Display", two USB ports, ILI9341
description: The CYD with a micro-USB and a USB-C port, in its ILI9341 batch: 2.8" 240x320 ILI9341 with XPT2046 resistive touch on a second SPI bus. Same pins as the original CYD.
verify: Pins are the Sunton CYD's, which the two-USB board shares (witnessmenow/ESP32-Cheap-Yellow-Display). Stored portrait (240 x 320) because the original CYD preset, stored landscape for its own glass, draws this panel squashed and striped. Colour order BGR with inversion off is what a user's own board needed to look as designed (2026-10-21), as an ILI9341 at 240 x 320; touch was not reported on separately. If the picture is a negative, turn Invert on; if red and blue are swapped, set RGB; if colours look washed out, the same notes report a gamma fault on some of these boards. If this preset gives a white screen, the panel is the ST7789 batch: use the ST7789 preset.
